description: Build around one item (by id from an earlier result). For fashion it returns one piece per missing slot of an outfit (layer, top, bottom, shoes, bag, accessory; a dress skips top and bottom); for an interior piece it returns the other objects of a room (lamp, vase, table, textiles). Pieces are chosen for shared style, color harmony, shared occasion, season and a similar price tier, and never from the item's own slot. Use it for 'what goes with this', 'style this' or 'finish the room'; use find_similar for alternatives to the item itself. Filters apply to every added piece (for example max_price per piece, size or ship_to). Returns {anchor, kind, count, pieces}, each piece with a slot label and, with a key, a 'why'. An unknown id returns an error result. Read-only. Without a key, results are capped at 5 and omit trend data and match reasons; a free key (POST https://vitrine.fashion/v1/keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>') unlocks them. Rate limits: 10 calls a minute anonymous, 60 with a key.

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

filters.description: Hard filters. Applied before ranking; an item that fails any of them is never returned.

colors.description: Item must come in at least one of these colors.

gender.description: Department: women, men or unisex. 'men' returns men's and unisex pieces, 'women' returns women's and unisex pieces, 'unisex' returns unisex pieces only. Set gender_exact to true to drop the unisex pieces.

gender_exact.description: With gender, true matches that department only, without unisex pieces.

size.description: Item must be available in this size, e.g. 'M' or '32'.

subcategory.description: Product type, e.g. 'coat', 'sneakers', 'vase'. Exact values: vocabulary.

id.description: The item to build around, from an earlier result.

why.description: One-line reason it matches. With a key.
